library(dplyr)
library(jmv)
data <- data |>
  dplyr::arrange(GROUP)
# SPLIT FILE BY GROUP
# Note: In SPSS, SPLIT FILE runs subsequent analyses separately per group.
# In R/jmv, use the splitBy argument in analysis functions, or filter manually.
# Grouping variable: GROUP
jmv::descriptives(
  data = data,
  vars = c('SCORE'),
  freq = FALSE,
  mean = TRUE,
  median = TRUE,
  sd = TRUE,
  min = TRUE,
  max = TRUE,
  skew = TRUE,
  kurt = TRUE,
  missing = TRUE
)
# SPLIT FILE OFF
# Subsequent analyses apply to the full dataset (no grouping)
